title: Open Browser Event Channel
description: Attach the current MCP control session to a bounded resumable channel for typed events published by the Extension. The channel is generic infrastructure and does not start a workflow, recording, or browser action.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for opening a bounded browser event channel.

topics.description: Event topics to attach to this control-session-scoped channel. page: page.navigated, page.opened (a tab your page opened), page.closed, page.authentication.required / .cleared; your own pages report to you alone, pages no agent owns to every channel. interaction: your own steps (interaction.step.*) and session events. execution: execution.started / .status / .progress / .finished of runs in this browser, and execution.handoff.opened / .closed when a run opens or closes a repair handoff (details handoffId, endpoint, waitingOn), even under a sign-in pause whose status does not change. monitor: every task and page of the browser whoever started it (dsagent.monitor.snapshot as it changes): monitor.task.started / .status / .ended, monitor.attention.raised / .cleared (code and who it waits on), monitor.assist.started / .ended; off while the person turned the monitor off.

leaseTtlSeconds.description: Optional channel lease in seconds; the Extension applies its default when omitted.

outputSchema.description: Opened browser event channel and initial cursor.

channelId.description: Opaque identifier for the opened event channel.

resumeToken.description: Opaque token for resuming reads from the same channel.

cursor.description: Initial event cursor for subsequent waits.
